hook: Broke by the 15th? It's not your salary.

beats.overlay: Broke by the 15th? It's not your salary.
beats.vo: If your money disappears before payday, it is almost never the big stuff.
It is the leaks. The small taps you never notice add up faster than rent.

beats.overlay: Read your last 30 days out loud
beats.vo: Open your bank app and read the last thirty days out loud. Circle every subscription, every delivery, every quick tap. Most people find two to four hundred dollars a month they forgot they were spending.
Then give every dollar a job before the month starts. Fifty percent needs, thirty percent wants, twenty percent savings and debt.

cta.overlay: Save this. Do the read-out tonight.
cta.vo: Save this and follow for the no-budget money system.

caption:
Read your last 30 days out loud. You'll be shocked. 👀

The leaks — not the big purchases — are what keep you broke. Give every dollar a job before the month starts.

Save this for your next payday. 💸
